notes: All 7 web searches ran (the 6 required plus one on his name with "artificial intelligence"). None returned a page quoting or naming Rep. No source showed him sponsoring or co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act or leading a House letter on AI risk; co-sponsor lists were not checked directly on congress.gov. Carried over from the earlier attempt: bost.house.gov home page and press release listing pages 1 to 5 (https://bost.house.gov/press-releases?page=1 to 5, covering 13 Feb 2025 to 9 Nov 2026) were opened; no release title mentioned AI or technology, and the 23 Jul 2026 defense authorization release and 24 Feb 2026 State of the Union statement do not mention AI. Only titles were checked for the other releases, and House Veterans' Affairs Committee pages (he chairs that committee) and floor speeches were not checked.
